=== facets.Compute
  [0] Select: SELECT multiIf( grouping(service) = 0, 'service', grouping(host) = 0, 'host', grouping(pod) = 0, 'pod', grouping(environment) = 0, 'environment', '' ) AS dim, multiIf( grouping(service) = 0, service, grouping(host) = 0, host, grouping(pod) = 0, pod, grouping(environment) = 0, environment, '' ) AS value, count() AS cnt FROM optikk.logs PREWHERE tenant_id = @tenantID AND timestamp BETWEEN @start AND @end AND ts_bucket BETWEEN @startBucket AND @endBucket AND service IN @services WHERE 1=1 AND upper(severity_text) IN @severities AND trace_id = @traceID AND lowerUTF8(body) LIKE @search AND attributes_string[@akey_0] = @aval_0 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (service), (host), (pod), (environment) ) HAVING value != '' ORDER BY dim, cnt DESC LIMIT @facetLimit BY dim
      @akey_0 = string "k"
      @aval_0 = string "v"
      @end = time.Time 2026-01-02T08:06:40Z
      @endBucket = uint32 0x69577c2c
      @facetLimit = uint64 0x32
      @search = string "%timeout%"
      @services = []string []string{"api"}
      @severities = []string []string{"ERROR"}
      @start = time.Time 2026-01-02T02:06:40Z
      @startBucket = uint32 0x695727cc

=== trends.Trend
  [0] Select: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 300 SECOND) AS time_bucket, count() AS total, countIf(severity_bucket >= 4) AS error, countIf(severity_bucket = 3) AS warn, countIf(severity_bucket = 2) AS info, countIf(severity_bucket <= 1) AS debug FROM optikk.logs PREWHERE tenant_id = @tenantID AND timestamp BETWEEN @start AND @end AND ts_bucket BETWEEN @startBucket AND @endBucket AND service IN @services WHERE 1=1 AND upper(severity_text) IN @severities AND trace_id = @traceID AND lowerUTF8(body) LIKE @search AND attributes_string[@akey_0] = @aval_0 GROUP BY time_bucket ORDER BY time_bucket ASC
      @akey_0 = string "k"
      @aval_0 = string "v"
      @end = time.Time 2026-01-02T08:06:40Z
      @endBucket = uint32 0x69577c2c
      @search = string "%timeout%"
      @services = []string []string{"api"}
      @severities = []string []string{"ERROR"}
